dataset: City of Vancouver Open Data, Public trees (public-trees)
attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Vancouver.
note: Boulevard and park trees owned by the City; private trees not included. Heights are classes (mostly 4.6, 7.6, 10.7 m).
tiles: r_<i>_<j>.json, same grid as t_ tiles (T=1500 m)
fields: r = flat list of x, y (units of 1/Q m from the tile corner, Q=2), h_dm (height, decimetres; -1 none), d_cm (trunk diameter, cm; -1 none)
city_test: inside the zoning overview grown by 40 m (20 m cells); approximate: no city-limit file in the tool
